body:
## Summary

Coordinate the v0.92 quality and release-tail wave after terminal #343. #307 owns dependency truth, child merge/readiness reconciliation, sprint review, final release-tail reconciliation, and umbrella closeout; every child retains independent implementation, review, publication, merge, and terminal authority.

Prior legacy-number descriptions remain in issue history but are superseded by this canonical current-repository scope.

## Entry Gate

#343 must be terminal, canonical, ancestral, and clean before #308 executes. Preparation and design review may complete before that gate.

## Current Child Inventory

- #308 — WP-20 demo matrix, AEE proof, and proof coverage.
- #309 — WP-21 repository-wide reduction cleanup.
- #310 — WP-21A Rust refactoring and maintainability.
- #311 — WP-22 quality gate.
- #312 — WP-23 documentation and release-truth pass.
- #313 — WP-25 internal review.
- #314 — WP-26 external review intake and retained review report.
- #315 — WP-27 review-finding dispositions and remediation ownership.
- #471 — WP-27 remediation subissue under #315; not an independent release-tail lane.
- #316 — WP-28 next-milestone planning.
- #317 — WP-28A closeout plan.
- #318 — WP-29 next-milestone review.
- #319 — WP-30 release ceremony.

## Canonical Child Graph

#309 remains active v0.92 WP-21 work. The exact release-tail graph is `#308 -> #309 -> #310 -> #311 -> #312 -> #313 -> #314 -> #315 -> #316 -> #317 -> #318 -> #319`, with #471 recorded as a #315/WP-27 child remediation issue.

#310 consumes #309's reviewed post-deletion head and inventory. Later children wait for the predecessor state required by their own issue contract. Ordinary successor work depends on reviewed, green, merged predecessor truth and explicit handoff readiness, not individual issue closeout paperwork.

## Current Routing Notes

- #268 is closed successfully and no longer blocks Sprint 6 or milestone closeout.
- #314 and #315 remain open until the external review findings are actually retained, dispositioned, and fixed or explicitly routed.
- #471 is part of WP-27/#315 remediation and should be tracked as a child finding-fix issue, not as a sibling release-tail lane.
- #316 can proceed from documented review/remediation truth and does not wait for unrelated closeout paperwork.
- #317 owns final closeout-plan truth after #316 is published.

## Coordination Requirements

For every included child, require exact issue/PR identity, current exact-head review where required, green required checks, merged revision or explicit route, merge ancestry, residual risks, and accepted handoff before dependent implementation advances.

Typed terminal cache, canonical match, and registered-worktree cleanup are final #307 closeout evidence. They are asynchronous bookkeeping and do not gate unrelated successor issue work once the predecessor merge/readiness contract is satisfied.

## Owned Scope

- `.csdlc/issues/307/**`
- `.csdlc/prepared/issues/307/**`
- `.csdlc/evidence/307/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92/review/sprint_307/**`

All child implementation, review, release, tag, deployment, provider, and AWS paths remain read-only.

## Exit Criteria

- The exact #308-through-#319 child graph remains explicit, acyclic, and complete.
- #471 remains recorded under #315/WP-27 remediation.
- Required child merge/readiness facts are reconciled before dependent work advances.
- Final #307 closeout reconciles terminal, canonical, ancestral, cleanup, residual-risk, and handoff truth without retroactively blocking already-unblocked successor work.
- Review findings are resolved or explicitly routed.
- Release evidence and claims agree with landed exact revisions.
- WP-30's separately authorized ceremony is verified by live readback.
- One exact-head sprint review passes before #307 closes.
- v0.93 receives the accepted handoff without implicit activation.

## Failure Policy

Fail closed on child-graph drift, an unmerged or unrouted child required by a successor, nonancestral merge, red checks, stale review, unsupported release claim, partial tag/release identity, missing final closeout reconciliation, or cyclic handoff.

## Graph

`#343 -> #308 -> #309 -> #310 -> #311 -> #312 -> #313 -> #314 -> #315 -> #316 -> #317 -> #318 -> #319 -> #307 closeout`; #471 is a #315/WP-27 child; closeout records are async final-umbrella evidence only.
